abilities.name: Codex Discipline
abilities.legend: Deployed as a mutually supportive strike force that epitomises the flexibility and martial wisdom of the Codex Astartes, Space Marines have the answer to any strategic or tactical challenge.
abilities.description: You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.

abilities.name: Ironstorm Auto-targeters
abilities.legend: Space Marine armoured formations rapidly share cogitated targeting data to augment their already superb marksmanship and reaction times.
abilities.description:
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units’ (excluding walker units) ranged attacks can:
• Re-roll one hit roll.
• Re-roll one wound roll.

abilities.name: Lightning-fast Strike
abilities.legend: Racing into battle at breakneck speeds, Space Marine fast-attack squadrons often punch into the enemy lines before the foe even realises their peril.
abilities.description: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder units have +2" M.

abilities.name: Mission Tactics
abilities.legend:
Thousands of years of collated strategic data and hard-won combat experience have provided the Deathwatch with the ultimate battlefield tactics to combat almost any foe.

FUROR TACTICS When the enemy horde grows close, the Deathwatch will be tasked with the decimation of their core. Aiming not for clinical kills but for maximum destruction over a wide area, they tear the heart from the enemy army.

MALLEUS TACTICS When the giants of war lumber forth, the Deathwatch will adopt Malleus tactics. Even the largest behemoth has a weak point, and the archives of the Deathwatch number them all.

PURGATUS TACTICS By adopting Purgatus tactics, the Deathwatch focus their deadly ire upon the commanders of the enemy host, assassinating them one after another with pitiless head shots and killing thrusts of the blade.
abilities.description:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:

Furor Tactics: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Malleus Tactics: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

Purgatus Tactics: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].

RESTRICTIONS: Your army can include ADEPTUS ASTARTES DEATHWATCH units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

With the exception of Kill Team Cassius (see Legends: Agents of the Imperium), your army cannot include any AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEATHWATCH units.

abilities.name: Vowed Target
abilities.legend: Whether its true significance is kept a secret or not, there is a singular prize here that the Inner Circle have come to either secure or destroy. They will pursue this strategic objective with cold ferocity.
abilities.description:
In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one objective. That objective is your vowed objective until your next Command phase.
• Friendly Deathwing Infantry unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within range of your vowed objective have +1 to wound rolls.

Restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Legacy of the Angel
abilities.legend: Never do the Blood Angels stand taller or strive harder than when faced with seemingly impossible odds. At such times, the Sons of Sanguinius delve deep into their souls for preternatural reserves of determination, fury and focus. Sometimes, they even touch upon the uncertain gift of prophecy that was said to be their gene‑sire’s boon and his curse.
abilities.description:
Friendly Blood Angels Character units:
• Can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• Can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

Restrictions: Your army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: The Great Wolf Watches
abilities.legend: The battle‑brothers of this Great Company know what their lord expects of them and stand ready to pounce the moment the foe are fool enough to stray within range.
abilities.description:
Friendly Adeptus Astartes Character units have the following ability:

Countercharge: (Once per battle round, per unit) When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1CP.

abilities.name: Dutiful Tenacity
abilities.legend: Even amongst the Adeptus Astartes, the battle‑brothers of the Dark Angels are renowned for their tenacity and resilience on the battlefield. When ordered to war, they are utterly relentless in pursuing their objectives, wading into fields of withering fire and shrugging off blows that would slay mortal warriors outright.
abilities.description:
Attacks that target friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted units with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

Restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Legendary Slayers
abilities.legend: Some Space Wolves seek only to bring down the most monstrous and deadly foes. With hunting packs of Fenrisian wolves, Thunderwolf Cavalry and rampaging bands of Wulfen, they seek to hunt down and slay mighty champions, towering monstrosities and rumbling war machines, demoralising the foe and earning glorious victories.
abilities.description: Attacks made by friendly Blood Claws/Thunderwolf Cavalry/Wulfen units have [Lethal Hits: Character/Monster/Vehicle].

abilities.name: Vulkan's Quest
abilities.legend: Tireless in his pursuit of the Primarch’s legacy, Forgefather Vulkan He’stan annihilates any who impede his quest. Favouring swift, aggressive assaults, he and his warriors close rapidly with the enemy, destroying them at close range with ruthless efficiency
abilities.description:
• You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.
• Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units’ ranged attacks that target a unit within 12", have +1 S.

If your army includes a Vulkan He’stan unit, friendly Infernus Squad units have the following:
• When this unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move, that advance/fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.
• When this unit starts an action, that action does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.

Restrictions: Your army can include Salamanders units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Shadow Tactics
abilities.legend: The Raven Guard are renowned for their uncanny ability to move unseen, cloaking themselves in darkness as they close in upon their prey. Aethon Shaan is a true master at harnessing these abilities, withdrawing and redeploying his battle-brothers to draw the enemy out of formation.
abilities.description:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units have Stealth.

Friendly Phobos/Scout Squad units have -3" detection range.

Friendly Aethon Shaan units have the following ability:

Unparalleled Tactician: (Once per battle round, per army) When you use the Into Darkness stratagem, that use is -1CP.

abilities.name: Storm-swift Onslaught
abilities.legend: The White Scars are masters of high‑speed tactics and hit‑and‑run warfare. They do battle on the move and from the saddle, outwitting their enemies with breakneck manoeuvres and melting away one moment only to crash home with bone‑crushing force the next.
abilities.description:
• You can select the assault doctrine or tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.
• Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder units have +1 to advance rolls.

Friendly Suboden Khan units have the following ability:

Wrath of the First Khan: At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit was eligible to fight this phase, you can use this ability. If you do:
• If this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move.
• Or: If this unit is engaged, this unit can make a fall-back move.

Restrictions: Your army can include White Scars units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Mastered Doctrines
abilities.legend: Marneus Calgar deploys the complete and nuanced wisdom of the Codex Astartes as easily and instinctively as drawing breath.
abilities.description: If your army includes a Marneus Calgar unit, you can select the assault doctrine/devastator doctrine/tactical doctrine each one additional time per battle.

abilities.name: Master of Wolves
abilities.legend:
When the Great Wolf Logan Grimnar leads his packs to war, it is certain that mighty deeds will be done and epic verses added to the sagas of many a Space Wolf. There is none amongst the sons of Russ who can command such instinctive authority throughout his Chapter, none who so deftly wields warrior and war engine like a single great pack. In the sight of their lord, every Space Wolf aspires to be a champion of Fenris and strives with ever-greater determination to prove themselves worthy of his regard. Grimnar masterfully directs the hunt from its very heart, orchestrating every element like an apex predator herding its prey to destruction. Where restraint is needed, he sees it exercised. Where focused fury must be unleashed, he is its master and embodiment both. So does the saga of Logan Grimnar grow ever greater for the telling.

HOWLING ONSLAUGHT
When the Great Wolf gives the command, his packs descend upon the foe in a coordinated and utterly devastating strike.
abilities.description:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLES units) with this ability have the following abilities:

Encircling Jaws: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.

Hunter’s Eye: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s ranged attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

Ferocious Strike: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit with 9" have [Sustained Hits 1].

Friendly Logan Grimnar units have the following ability:

Howling Onslaught: (Once per battle, per army) In your command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly Adeptus Astartes Monster/Vehicle units benefit from the Master of Wolves rule until the start of your next command phase.

Restrictions: Your army can include Space Wolves units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Adaptive Defence
abilities.legend: These Space Marines are experts in fighting from rapidly prepared defensive positions. They are able to maximise the potential of almost any terrain to serve as an ad-hoc strongpoint, rapidly assessing optimal firing lines and punishing the foe’s every attempt to advance and dislodge them.
abilities.description:
• While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within a terrain area, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
• Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units are entrenched while all of the following apply:
• That unit is within a terrain area.
• That unit was not set up this turn.
• No model in that unit moved more than 3" this turn.

• Friendly Darnath Lysander/Tor Garadon units have the following ability:
Defensive Mastery: At the start of each phase, this unit is entrenched.

DARNATH LYSANDER’s/TOR GARADON’s unit is always entrenched, regardless of the conditions listed above.

Restrictions: Your army can include Imperial Fists units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Faith-fuelled Resolve
abilities.legend: Uncompromising in their faith, a crusade's Sword Brethren are blazing beacons of intolerant resolve capable of holding back hordes of blasphemous foes from sites sacred to the Black Templars.
abilities.description:
In the Fight phase, if a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit is within range of an objective, that unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.

Restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Wrath of Angels
abilities.legend: Few living warriors embody the ideal of the Emperor's wrathful angels more than the Sanguinary Guard, for they appear without warning to wreak death and destruction before surging on to the next foe with shocking speed.
abilities.description:
The tactical doctrine is active for Sanguinary Guard units in addition to any other combat doctrine.

Restrictions: Your army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Sanguinius' Fury
abilities.legend: Swept up in visions of the Primarch’s blood-drenched final hours, the Lost throw themselves upon the foe, channelling the Great Angel’s fury and striving their utmost to emulate his mastery of close-quarters combat.
abilities.description:
Friendly DEATH COMPANY units have the following:
• At the start of each phase, the assault doctrine is active for this unit.
• The devastator/tactical doctrine cannot be active for this unit.
This means that, regardless of any other rules, DEATH COMPANY units can never have an active doctrine other than the assault doctrine.

Restrictions: Your army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Black-winged Vigilance
abilities.legend: The anti-grav skimmers and combat aircraft of the Ravenwing bristle not only with potent weapons but also with powerful augurs and trackers, whose sleepless machine spirits are as vigilant as the black-armoured battle-brothers.
abilities.description:
Friendly Ravenwing Fly units’ ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

Friendly Outrider squad units have BATTLELINE.

Restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Mission Tactics
abilities.legend: Thousands of years of collated strategic data and hard-won combat experience have provided the Deathwatch with the ultimate battlefield tactics to combat almost any foe.
abilities.description:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:

Furor Tactics
If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Malleus Tactics
If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

Purgatus Tactics
If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].

DEATHWATCH ALLIES
You can include Deathwatch units in your army, even though they do not have the same Chapter faction keyword as other units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.

When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated, you cannot select a DEATHWATCH model to be your WARLORD. In addition KILL TEAM units can only contain enhancements taken from this detachment.

This an exception to the Space Marine Chapters Army Rules.

abilities.name: Templar Vows
abilities.legend: On the eve of battle, the Black Templars gather to be led in prayer and contemplation by their champions. United in their hatred of the foe, they swear a mighty vow to uphold in the battle ahead.
abilities.description:
At the start of the first battle round, you can select one Vow listed below. That Vow is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units until the end of the battle.

Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch
This unit’s melee attacks that target a PSYKER unit:
• Have [PRECISION].
• Have [LANCE].

Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds
Friendly melee attacks that target a unit with a T greater than this unit’s S have +1 to wound rolls.

Uphold the Honour of the Emperor
Friendly INFANTRY units have:
• At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.
• When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

Restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Purge and Sanctify
abilities.legend: As the battle-brothers of a Vindication Task Force purge the Emperor’s domain in fire and blood, they see their holy quest as recovering Humanity’s rightful dominion. They scour the stain of the unclean, topple false idols, breach strongholds of unholy faith and plant the crusade’s standards in their place, branding such sites with the sacred icons of their brotherhood.
abilities.description:
Each time a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit makes a surge move, instead of selecting a surge target, you can select the closest objective to that unit. When that unit makes that surge move, each model in that unit must end that surge move as close as possible to that objective instead.

Restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

abilities.name: Armoured Wrath
abilities.description:
Each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot or selected to fight apply one of the following when resolving those attacks:
• If that unit is within 6" of a friendly Cannok Var/Iron Father Feirros unit you can:
• Re-roll one hit roll.
• Re-roll one wound roll.
• Re-roll one damage roll.

• Otherwise you can:
• Re-roll one hit roll.
• Or: Re-roll one wound roll.
• Or: Re-roll one damage roll.

abilities.name: Combined Deployment
abilities.legend: Space Marine crews train to provide armoured fire support to their debarked passengers while on the attack.
abilities.description:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn:
• While a unit is assailed, when an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

abilities.name: Shadow Masters
abilities.legend: Holding to the shadows and choosing victims with care, Phobos-armoured Astartes winnow the enemy ranks without ever revealing their positions.
abilities.description:
When a friendly Phobos or Scout SQUAD unit has shot:
• Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden.
• Or: That unit can make a normal move of up to D6". That unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Chapter
abilities.legend: When the Space Marines are roused to true martial fury, they bring their vengeance to their adversaries with the inescapable speed of a lightning strike.
abilities.description: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.

abilities.name: Vanguard Ambushers
abilities.legend: Few experiences are so terrifying for Mankind’s enemies as finding themselves the victims of Phobos-armoured ambushers.
abilities.description: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly Phobos unit is hidden, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Death Blow
abilities.legend: Veterans of a hundred decapitating strikes, these First Company warriors know that if they land their first blow with sufficiently furious momentum, they will need no second.
abilities.description: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls.

abilities.name: Assault Mastery
abilities.legend: Space Marines who specialise in close-quarters brutality truly embody their sobriquet ‘Angels of Death’.
abilities.description: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.

abilities.name: Walking Fortress
abilities.legend: With their plan in motion and targets designated, Gravis-armoured warriors stride unstoppably into battle as they lay down withering hails of firepower.
abilities.description:
In a turn a friendly Gravis unit made a normal move, that unit’s ranged attacks:
• Do not have [Heavy].
• Have +1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Devastator Mastery
abilities.legend: Unceasing and unmerciful, Adeptus Astartes fire support formations lay waste to all that falls under their gunsights.
abilities.description: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.

abilities.name: Indomitable Defence
abilities.legend: The Adeptus Astartes stand as an adamantine wall against any who would assail the Emperor’s realm.
abilities.description: While a friendly Gravis unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

abilities.name: Tactical Mastery
abilities.legend: Rarely are the Adeptus Astartes deadlier than when they bring to bear the most fundamental teachings of the Codex Astartes.
abilities.description: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

abilities.name: Enduring Vengeance
abilities.legend: Those who pilot Dreadnoughts combine the skill of undying champions with a cold and vengeful hatred of the Emperor’s countless enemies.
abilities.description: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

abilities.name: Codex Fire-patterns
abilities.legend: Faced with multiple threats that must be efficiently eliminated, the Space Marines employ time-honoured ballistic doctrines to great effect.
abilities.description: Friendly Tacticus units’ [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units up to that attack’s maximum range.

datasheets.name: Apothecary Biologis
datasheets.legend: Clad in Gravis armour, the Apothecary Biologis can advance through storms of enemy fire, vivispectrum at the ready to take bio-material samples for later analysis, whether that be xenos flesh, viral weapons casings or esoteric gene-tech.
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Absolvor Bolt Pistol; 1 Servo-armature.

abilities.name: Support
abilities.description:
Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it.

Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it.

abilities.name: Combat Doctrines
abilities.description:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

ASSAULT DOCTRINEWhen this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

DEVASTATOR DOCTRINEThis unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

TACTICAL DOCTRINEWhen this unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.
Unless otherwise stated:
• You can only select each combat doctrine once per battle.
• Only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

abilities.name: Vivispectral Analysis Targeting
abilities.description: This unit’s attacks have [Lethal Hits: non-Vehicle].

datasheets.name: Land Raider
datasheets.legend: Land Raiders are mobile fortresses that bear squads of Space Marines through the most furious firestorms without so much as a scratch. Their machine spirits are so potent that if the crew are slain they will take over, making the tank a truly formidable asset.
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Armoured Tracks; 2 Godhammer Lascannon; 1 Twin Heavy Bolter.
datasheets.transport: This model has a transport capacity of 14 Adeptus Astartes Infantry models. It cannot transport Jump Pack models. Each Gravis/Terminator model takes up the space of 2 models.

abilities.name: Damaged 6
abilities.description: This ability always takes the form Damaged X. While a model’s remaining wounds are equal to or less than X, that model is damaged: while damaged, that model’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise D6
abilities.description: This ability always takes the form Deadly Demise X. Each time a model with this ability is destroyed, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their emergency disembark moves, roll one D6. On a 6, that model suffers a deadly demise; each unit within 6" of that model suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by X (if this is a random number, roll separately for each unit within 6").

abilities.name: Assault Ramp
abilities.description: In your Movement phase, when this unit ends a normal move, units embarked within this unit can make an assault disembark move.

abilities.name: Power of the Machine Spirit
abilities.description:
This unit’s ranged attacks can:
• Re-roll one hit roll.
• Re-roll one wound roll.

wargearOptions: This model can be equipped with 1 Hunter-killer Missile.
This model can be equipped with 1 Multi-melta.
This model can be equipped with 1 Storm Bolter.

datasheets.name: Land Raider Crusader
datasheets.legend: The Land Raider Crusader is a superlative assault tank. Its bulk enables it to crush enemy defences, and its prodigious firepower cuts their defenders to ribbons. With an enhanced transport capacity, once it has stormed enemy defences, Space Marines pour from its hatches to slaughter those foes who remain.
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Armoured Tracks; 2 Hurricane Bolter; 1 Twin Assault Cannon.
datasheets.transport: This model has a transport capacity of 16 Adeptus Astartes Infantry models. It cannot transport Jump Pack models. Each Gravis/Terminator model takes up the space of 2 models.

wargearOptions: This model can be equipped with 1 Hunter-killer Missile.
This model can be equipped with 1 Multi-melta.
This model can be equipped with 1 Storm Bolter.

datasheets.name: Land Raider Excelsior
datasheets.loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Armoured Tracks; 2 Godhammer Lascannon; 1 Grav-cannon.
datasheets.transport: This model has a transport capacity of 12 Adeptus Astartes Infantry models. Each Jump Pack, Gravis, Terminator model takes up the space of 2 models. Each Centurion model takes up the space of 3 models.

abilities.name: Rites of Battle
abilities.description: Once per battle round, one unit from your army with this ability can use it when it is targeted with a stratagem. If it does, reduce the cost of that stratagem by 1 CP.

wargearOptions: This model can be equipped with 1 Multi-melta
This model can be equipped with 1 Hunter-killer Missile
This model can be equipped with 1 Storm Bolter
This model can be equipped with 1 Combi-weapon - Damnatus

datasheets.name: Bladeguard Veteran Squad
datasheets.legend: Bladeguard Veterans are inexorable warriors, advancing relentlessly with blades held high – the very image of noble knights of myth. Members of their Chapter’s elite 1st Company of Veterans, each of these vastly experienced Space Marines has fought to preserve the Imperium across uncounted worlds.
datasheets.loadout: Every model is equipped with: 1 Heavy Bolt Pistol; 1 Master-crafted Power Sword.

abilities.name: Combat Doctrines
abilities.description:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase.

This ability always takes the form Scouts X". In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following:
• If that unit is in strategic reserves, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone.
• If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a scout move (see below).
• If that unit is embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts ability, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT can make a scout move.

SCOUT MOVE

MAXIMUM DISTANCE: The X" in Scouts X".

ELIGIBLE IF: It is the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, and your unit is wholly within your deployment zone.

EFFECT: Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).

AFTER MOVING: Your unit must be more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units.

• If that unit is in strategic reserves, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone.
• If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a scout move (see below).
• If that unit is embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts ability, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT can make a scout move.

SCOUT MOVE

MAXIMUM DISTANCE: The X" in Scouts X".

ELIGIBLE IF: It is the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, and your unit is wholly within your deployment zone.

EFFECT: Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).

AFTER MOVING: Your unit must be more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units.

• If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a scout move (see below).
• If that unit is embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts ability, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT can make a scout move.

SCOUT MOVE

MAXIMUM DISTANCE: The X" in Scouts X".

ELIGIBLE IF: It is the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, and your unit is wholly within your deployment zone.

EFFECT: Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).

AFTER MOVING: Your unit must be more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Scouts 6"
abilities.description:
This ability always takes the form Scouts X". In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following:
• If that unit is in strategic reserves, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone.
• If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a scout move (see below).
• If that unit is embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts ability, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT can make a scout move.

SCOUT MOVE

MAXIMUM DISTANCE: The X" in Scouts X".

ELIGIBLE IF: It is the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, and your unit is wholly within your deployment zone.

EFFECT: Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).

AFTER MOVING: Your unit must be more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Firing Deck 7
abilities.description:
This ability always takes the form Firing Deck X. In your Shooting phase, each time this TRANSPORT is selected to shoot, if one or more units are embarked within it, resolve the following sequence:
• Select up to X models embarked within this TRANSPORT (excluding models whose units have already been selected to shoot this phase).
• For each selected model, select one of its ranged weapons (excluding [ONE SHOT] weapons).
• Until this TRANSPORT has resolved all of its attacks, it has all of those selected weapons in addition to its other weapons.
• Until the end of the turn, units embarked within this TRANSPORT are not eligible to shoot.

abilities.name: Assigned Agents
abilities.description:
If your Army Faction is AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, then in the Select Detachment Rules step, you can select one of the available Detachments from this book as normal.

If your Army Faction is not AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, but every model in your army has the IMPERIUM keyword, you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units in your army even if they do not have the Faction keyword you selected in the Select Army Faction step. In this case, the maximum number of AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as shown below.

BATTLE SIZERETINUE UNITSCHARACTER UNITSREQUISITIONED UNITSIncursion111Strike Force221Onslaught332

Note that you can include AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEDICATED TRANSPORT units in such an army as normal, but each unit must start the battle with one or more units embarked within it, or it cannot be deployed for that battle and will count as having been destroyed during the first battle round.

abilities.name: Kill Team
abilities.description:
Each time an attack targets this unit, if it contains models with different Toughness characteristics, until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, use the Toughness characteristic of the majority of the models in that unit when determining what roll is required for that attack to successfully wound. If two or more Toughness characteristics are tied for majority, use the highest value.

For the purposes of determining which models in this unit can embark within a Transport, Kill Team Terminator models, Kill Team Outrider models, Kill Team Biker models and models equipped with a jump pack each take up the space of 2 models, but can otherwise embark within any TRANSPORT their unit can embark within, even though similar models in other units have the Terminator, Mounted or Jump Pack keywords.

For the purposes of interacting with terrain features, all models in units with this ability are considered INFANTRY models, even though similar models in other units may have the MOUNTED or JUMP PACK keywords.

Designer’s Note: While the abstractions in the above rule cause some models to behave differently to similar models in other units, they are designed to minimise complicated movement, TRANSPORT and Benefit of Cover rules.

SCOUT MOVE

MAXIMUM DISTANCE: The X" in Scouts X".

ELIGIBLE IF: It is the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, and your unit is wholly within your deployment zone.

EFFECT: Your unit moves as described in Moving (03).

stratagems.name: EVASIVE REPOSITIONING
stratagems.legend: Codex doctrine when conducting an aggressive defence is to swiftly take up new positions whenever the foe finds your range.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.

EFFECT:
• Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".
• Or: If your unit is entrenched, your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
Your unit is not able to embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: ESTABLISH SUPREMACY
stratagems.legend: Steadfast and determined, the Imperial Fists favour methodical advances, securing and consolidating positions to establish battlefield dominance before turning their attention to the elimination of remaining foes.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly entrenched ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to make a consolidation move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

Designer’s Note: This means your unit can move out of engagement range with enemy units, provided it meets the conditions of the objective consolidation mode.

stratagems.name: PRIORITY STRIKE
stratagems.legend: Eliminating key enemy assets is crucial to stalling then reversing the foe’s momentum.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, have +1 to wound rolls.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s attacks that target a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: AUGMENTED TARGETING
stratagems.legend: Auto-sense targeting subroutines specially adapted for defensive fire patterns aid these warriors’ aim.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have:
• [LETHAL HITS].
• Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
• Or: If your unit is entrenched, [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: STAND TO THE END
stratagems.legend: Aware of how vital it is that the defence line holds, these warriors fight even to their last breath.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT:
• Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
• Or: If your unit is entrenched, attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

• Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
• Or: If your unit is entrenched, attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: UNYIELDING MIGHT
stratagems.legend: Knowing that this strategically vital site must be secure for the defence lines to hold, Space Marines stand indomitable in the face of the foe.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is within range of an objective.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.
stratagems.whenText: Command phase.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is within range of an objective.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

stratagems.name: BIRTH OF A SAGA
stratagems.legend: Heroes are forged in the heat of battle, rising from obscurity to become the warriors of epic sagas.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units).

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has CHARACTER.
stratagems.whenText: Your Command phase.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit (excluding Monster/Vehicle units).
stratagems.effectText: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has CHARACTER.

stratagems.name: HEROIC RESOLVE
stratagems.legend: This warrior’s indomitable fortitude is the stuff of legend, galvanizing his pack to remain standing before an avalanche of incoming attacks.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit.
stratagems.effectText: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: CHAMPION'S GUIDANCE
stratagems.legend: A paragon of Fenrisian savagery, this champion guides his warriors with confidence and precision.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Character unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: WINGS OF SHADOW
stratagems.legend: Through subtle manoeuvring and empowered cameleoline armour, the swiftest of the Ravenwing evade attempts to bring their hunt to an end.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Ravenwing Fly/Mounted unit.

TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Stealth.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Ravenwing Fly/Mounted unit.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit has Stealth.

stratagems.name: SKYBORNE SURVEILLANCE
stratagems.legend: The auspicators of the Ravenwing are sleepless, and from ideal hunting vantages, there is nowhere the foe can hide for long.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Ravenwing Fly unit has shot.

TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY unit.

EFFECT: Visible enemy units within 6" of your unit have +3" detection range.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Ravenwing Fly unit has shot.
stratagems.effectText: Visible enemy units within 6" of your unit have +3" detection range.

stratagems.name: WE ARE VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: The Ravenwing's aerial assets are capable of swift and reactive manoeuvring to new firing positions, ensuring opportunities for rapid vengeance.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Ravenwing Fly unit has shot.

TARGET: That RAVENWING FLY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Ravenwing Fly unit has shot.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Hellfire rounds douse their targets in voracious acids that are utterly lethal to organic life.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

stratagems.name: KRAKEN ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Kraken rounds utilise adamantine cores and improved propellants to penetrate the thickest hide.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
• Have +6" R.
• Have +1 S.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectText:

• Have +6" R.
• Have +1 S.

stratagems.name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.legend: Dragonfire rounds are designed to explode just before contact, saturating foes in cover with searing gas and flames.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks:
• Can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
• Have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.effectText:
Your unit’s ranged attacks:
• Can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
• Have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: BLACKSTAR EXTRACTION
stratagems.legend: Swooping low with transport bays yawning wide, Corvus Blackstar gunships extract Deathwatch warriors from the battlefield and convey them to locations where their lethal talents are most required.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged KILL TEAM unit.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
stratagems.whenText: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly unengaged KILL TEAM unit.
stratagems.effectText: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effectText: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: HAIL OF VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: Space Marines’ incredible battlefield awareness enables them to instinctively identify the origin of any enemy fire and punish their attackers.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a model in a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if those attacks destroyed a model in a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: STORM OF FIRE
stratagems.legend: There is no escaping the wrath of the Space Marines, and they use their weapons to bring swift death to their foes wherever they may hide.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
• [Ignores Cover].
• Or: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, [Ignores Cover] and +1 AP.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectText:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
• [Ignores Cover].
• Or: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, [Ignores Cover] and +1 AP.

stratagems.name: INEXORABLE VALOUR
stratagems.legend: Ever reaching for the heights of exemplary valour instilled in their forebears by Sanguinius, the golden host seize every opportunity to claim positions from which to strike anew.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit ends a fall-back move, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is unengaged.

TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit ends a fall-back move, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is unengaged.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: JUDGEMENT OF THE GOLDEN HOST
stratagems.legend: The meteoric impact of the Sanguinary Guard is an unavoidable judgement on those who have incurred the Chapter's wrath.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit form your army ends a charge move.

TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
• For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.whenText: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit form your army ends a charge move.
stratagems.effectText:
Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit:
• For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.name: BLINDING BLURS OF VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: When they power forward in rapid leaps, the glare emitted by their jump packs' nacelles reflecting from the mirrored gleam of their armour, the Sanguinary Guard seem to glow with a blinding radiance few can look upon.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit.

TARGET: That SANGUINARY GUARD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has:
• Stealth.
• -3" detection range.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Sanguinary Guard unit.
stratagems.effectText:
Your unit has:
• Stealth.
• -3" detection range.

stratagems.name: DOCTRINAL FLEXIBILITY
stratagems.legend: For all their zealous fury, the Black Templars are Space Marines still, capable of adapting their strategies in the midst of battle to ensure the foe’s destruction.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Crusader Squad unit.

EFFECT: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.
stratagems.whenText: Your Command phase.
stratagems.effectText: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: AVOWED DESTRUCTION
stratagems.legend: The Black Templars will see their oaths upheld at any cost. Any foe with the temerity to impede them in this goal must be put mercilessly to the sword.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: The Fight phase, when a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks:
• Have [LETHAL HITS].
• Or: Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
stratagems.whenText: The Fight phase, when a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.effectText:
Your unit’s melee attacks:
• Have [LETHAL HITS].
• Or: Have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: ANGELS DEFIANT
stratagems.legend: All too aware of their vital role in holding the foe at bay, these battle-brothers refuse to yield to even the most grievous of wounds.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

TARGET: That CRUSADER SQUAD unit.

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly CRUSADER SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effectText: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: WRATH AND RUIN
stratagems.legend: Having drawn their enemies in, Space Marine battle-brothers fall back and open fire at point-blank range before thundering forward to put any survivors to death.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.

EFFECT: The assault doctrine or tactical doctrine is active for your unit, until the start of your next Command phase.
stratagems.whenText: Your Command phase.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.
stratagems.effectText: The assault doctrine or tactical doctrine is active for your unit, until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: BLAZING EARTH
stratagems.legend: When faced with an onrushing horde, the Forgefather’s warriors set fire to the earth beneath their feet, impeding their advance and throwing them into confusion.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit equipped with one or more Torrent/Melta weapons.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.
stratagems.whenText: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit equipped with one or more Torrent/Melta weapons.
stratagems.effectText: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

stratagems.name: IMMOLATION PROTOCOLS
stratagems.legend: Salvo after salvo of burning promethium unleashed in synchronised waves will leave almost any foe as smouldering ash.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes infantry unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1 AP.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes infantry unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: BURNING VENGEANCE
stratagems.legend: To open fire on warriors of the Salamanders is merely to invite one’s own swift destruction.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit can:
• Make a disembark move.
• Shoot using normal shooting, but when doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.effectText:
Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit can:
• Make a disembark move.
• Shoot using normal shooting, but when doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: CRUCIBLE OF BATTLE
stratagems.legend: Only where the enemy can be faced eye to eye can a Space Marine be truly tested.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes infantry unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6".

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can:
• Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes infantry unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6".
stratagems.effectText:
Your unit’s attacks can:
• Re-roll hit rolls of 1.
• Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: FORGED IN FIRE
stratagems.legend: The Salamanders are masters of the flamer, wielding such weapons with supreme precision and utilising them even in the press of melee combat.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Torrent weapons:
• Do not have [Blast].
• Have [Close-Quarters].
• Have +1 A.

stratagems.effectText:
Your unit’s Torrent weapons:
• Do not have [Blast].
• Have [Close-Quarters].
• Have +1 A.

stratagems.name: DUTY IS NEVER DONE
stratagems.legend: There is no time to rest upon laurels while any portion of the Emperor’s realm remains in enemy hands.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.whenText: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase, is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit, and is eligible to embark within that TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.name: STORM AND SECURE
stratagems.legend: The advanced mechanised assault tactics employed by this force allow ground to be seized rapidly while on the move.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit that has an Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit embarked within it.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
stratagems.whenText: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit that has an Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit embarked within it.
stratagems.effectText: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: AGGRESSIVE DISEMBARKATION
stratagems.legend: Bursting out of their transport, the Space Marines are already on the move before their foes can react.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a Transport is selected to move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.
stratagems.whenText: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within a Transport is selected to move.
stratagems.effectText:
While making that move, each model in your unit can be set up within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

This allows you to set up your unit within the set-up distance of your TRANSPORT, instead of wholly within that distance.

stratagems.name: STORM OF DEVASTATION
stratagems.legend: Masters of the art of long-ranged warfare, these warriors unleash utter devastation upon their enemies.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: RESPONSIVE TACTICS
stratagems.legend: Space Marines know precisely when to give ground to leave enemies floundering, before surging back and driving them from the field in disarray.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: A WORTHY DEATH
stratagems.legend: Those Space Marines who specialise in close assault are ready to fight to their last breath and beyond to cut down more foes.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effectText:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.legend: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.
